setting.hex-cone-template-angle-hint: The default internal angle to use for the cone template on hex grids.
setting.square-cone-template-angle-hint: The default internal angle to use for the cone template on square grids.
setting.gridless-cone-template-angle-hint: The default internal angle to use for the cone template on gridless grids.
setting.hex-cone-snapping-angle-hint: The default snapping angle to use for the cone template on hex grids. 0 disables snapping.
setting.square-cone-snapping-angle-hint: The default snapping angle to use for the cone template on square grids. 0 disables snapping.
setting.gridless-cone-snapping-angle-hint: The default snapping angle to use for the cone template on gridless grids. 0 disables snapping.
setting.aura-collisions-highlight-hint: Show wall collisions on the current token level for aura highlights.
setting.default-grid-type-hint: The default grid type to use when making a new scene.
setting.default-top-elevation-hint: The default level top elevation to use when making a new scene.  Unset is +Infinity.
setting.default-bottom-elevation-hint: The default level bottom elevation to use when making a new scene. Unset is -Infinity.
setting.reach-exception-hint: Use the 10 foot reach exception on square grids as called out in the rules.
setting.flanking-angle-hint: Angle to use to consider an opposing token to be flanking.
setting.flanking-gridless-override-hint: Use the custom flanking logic on gridless maps. This logic checks the surface intersections points on an ellipsoid representation of the target.
setting.flanking-hex-override-hint: Use the custom flanking logic on hex maps. This logic checks the surface intersections points on an ellipsoid representation of the target.
setting.flanking-square-override-hint: Use the custom flanking logic on square maps. This logic checks the surface intersections points on an ellipsoid representation of the target.
